# IRoleProvider

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Marker interface for elements that declare a PDF structure role (heading level, paragraph, figure, …). When tagging is enabled, the render pipeline reads this role, pushes a corresponding structure element onto the tree, wraps the element's render in a marked-content sequence, and pops the element afterwards.

Elements that don't implement this interface render as before with no structure-tree contribution. Implementing the interface is strictly additive - untagged documents are unaffected because the pipeline checks `RenderContext.tagging` first.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).
